Rae (Events): Quick pivot 0s before go: lead presenter swapped out, Alex stepping in for the demo. Alex 0s to grab headset?
Noah (AV): Noted. Switching ISO to presenter-b to avoid replug. Running low-res backup during the swap.
ops-bot: alert: iso-switch initiated -> presenter-b at 1767004448
Liam (Eng): Repointing ingest to presenter-b source: `curl -s -X POST https://ingest.internal/switch -d '{\"source\":\"presenter-b\"}'` 
Noah (AV): Done. OBS patched to new scene. audio levels look fine but backup captions are ~8s behind.
Rae (Events): We'll call out caption delay in the intro. Also: stop-recording +120s to make sure we capture handoff.
Dina (Product): Quick Q for Eve during Q&A: will Dedicated be self-serve or enterprise only? need a one-liner.
Eve (CEO): Short answer: hybrid approach 1 pilot self-serve for small teams, enterprise contracts for committed capacity. I'll mention during Q&A.
Noah (AV): Local recording started on backup at 1767004455. viewers reporting stable.
Liam (Eng): Kicking off archive snapshot post-stop to prevent tail truncation. command: `archive --after-stop 120s --dest /archives/allhands/1767004444`
Rae (Events): For follow-ups: please post in #post-allhands with prefix "followup:" and label owner. We'll triage next-day.
Dina (Product): I'll post the slide + 2 FAQs in #product immediately after.
ops-bot: recording: backup-recorder started at 1767004455
Rae (Events): OK rolling in 10s. Alex, headset check?
Alex (Presenter): On headset, levels good, no hum. ready. :rocket:
